No active or archived identities changed. The ranking still labels its data period as the seven days from 2025-12-14 04:00 KST; observedFrom/To describe that historical ranking, not current API activity. Labanyu samples the one-hour Nexon API by exact item name and excludes some item types. Empty observations do not establish retirement.
